content: Horrible App. This software works fine on the computer with zoom, but this app continuously crashes. I’ve tried to upload an hour meeting on 10 different occasions, it crashed after 40 minutes all times. Does uploading really take as long as the meeting?!  Recorded numerous 2-3 minute dictations and again 10 minutes of waiting and when the phone locks it crashes the upload. Fix this app or don’t offer the service. Worst app experience I’ve ever had.
Don’t waste your money. Web app works fine but app doesn’t do anything. Never saves your recordings. Cancel and get Otter.ai for $100/yr instead.

Fails more than works. We are limited on what AI tools we can use and this was our only option from compliance.   Yet…it only works 1% of the time.   Like others we now have to redo meetings to make up for how this product lacks.
What is this?. No error messages, or explanation when you download the app. Waste of time

[APP] Weak. It attempts to do more than its capable of, misses critical information and most of all glosses over the context and personal aspects of meetings with AI gobbelly gook. The tasks it generates are mostly meaningless. Overall it wastes time and negatively impacts efficiency.
